model.name: Dangling tree links — a user clicks a chevron/link and it expands to EMPTY @390
model.description: USER-VISIBLE DEFECT (architect prod sweep, served v0.8.150; TYPE-CORRECT re-measure). A forward ref the tree TRAVERSES points to a unit that does not exist, so tapping the chevron/link expands to EMPTY. CORRECTED COUNT (architect owned an over-count): 17 user-facing dangling on the rendered surface = 15 Requirement.useCases -> dead UseCases + 1 Class + 1 Task. The earlier 41 (architect) and 469 (robbin-req working-tree) BOTH over-counted by including refs on keys the tree does NOT traverse (type-incorrect) + working-tree churn; 17 is the type-correct served number a user actually hits. RENDERED PROOF (better than any count): Requirement 1c3b86ad declares ONE useCase, that useCase is DEAD, prod returns ZERO children -> a user sees a Requirement whose ENTIRE chain is invisible. ★ CAVEAT (architect): a chunk of these are CROSS-BRANCH-UNCARRIED (the hotfix-vs-main divergence class) - some may VANISH on a carry, NOT need a code fix; an AC that assumes a code fix would be wrong.

discoverySource.note: PO delivery-first capture (LAW 2): user-visible @390 defect, screenshot-checkable AC. Fix ships in parallel; capture does not block delivery.

model.crossRefNote: Surfaces the user-visible face of the traceability-integrity family (R37.29 referential-integrity / R37.32 forward-authoritative). Same root, but stated in what the USER SEES @390, not model contents.
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED — OPEN DEFECT on served v0.8.150; fix ships (expert), Tron prioritizes; screenshot-@390 verifies.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On 390px, tapping any visible chevron/link expands to REAL content, never empty. RENDERED ANCHOR: Requirement 1c3b86ad today expands to zero children (its one useCase is dead) = the user sees a Requirement with an invisible chain. Screenshot: no expanded node is empty.

A forward ref whose target does not exist is NOT shown as a clickable chevron (hidden or shown disabled-with-reason), so a user cannot dead-click into emptiness. Screenshot: no live chevron yields nothing.

The type-correct served-tree dangling count (17: 15 Requirement.useCases->dead UseCase + 1 Class + 1 Task; traversed keys ONLY) trends to 0. Some resolve by a cross-branch CARRY (hotfix->main uncarried), not a code fix - the gate distinguishes carry-resolvable from code-fix-needed, and measures the SERVED build.

model.renderedProofAnchor: Requirement 1c3b86ad: 1 declared useCase, DEAD, prod 0 children => entire chain invisible to the user @390.
model.crossBranchCaveat: Some of the 17 are cross-branch-uncarried (hotfix vs main); may resolve on a CARRY not a code fix. AC must NOT assume code-fix-only.
